purpose: experiment8 Follow-up A — cot_strict_rotated_examples candidate pool. Per-attempt, the synthesis driver deterministically picks 3 of these 8 via random.Random(run_id).sample(...): same attempt index -> same 3 (reproducible); successive attempts rotate. Items 1-5 are the original cot_strict in-template examples (the documented collapse set, EXPERIMENT_DEEP_DIVE.md §6.1); items 6-8 are RE2-REJECTED syntax (RE2 is a finite-automaton engine) included deliberately to exercise the parser's error/rejection paths — consistent with the existing 'Lookarounds (rejected): (?=abc)' convention.
